'''''Persicaria barbata''''', commonly known as '''bearded knotweed''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Polygonaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=bearded knotweed (Persicaria barbata) |url=https://www.inaturalist.org/taxa/369916-Persicaria-barbata |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=iNaturalist |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Persicaria barbata in Flora of Pakistan @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=5&taxon_id=242100088 |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=www.efloras.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=CABI |date=2019-11-19 |title=Polygonum barbatum (knot grass) |url=https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/abs/10.1079/cabicompendium.42686 |journal=CABI Compendium |volume=CABI Compendium |article-number=42686 |doi=10.1079/cabicompendium.42686|doi-access=free }}</ref> It is native to the [[Arabian Peninsula]] and much of tropical and subtropical Asia, and has also been introduced to parts of Africa and the Pacific islands.<ref name = powo>{{Cite web |title=Persicaria barbata (L.) H.Hara {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:694917-1 |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref> The plant typically grows in seasonally dry tropical regions, where it occurs as an erect or sometimes prostrate annual herb, 30–60 cm tall, with hairless, line-grooved stems and lance-shaped leaves up to 15 cm long.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Persicaria barbata - Bearded Knotweed |url=https://www.flowersofindia.net/catalog/slides/Bearded%20Knotweed.html |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=www.flowersofindia.net}}</ref> In some descriptions it is noted as a perennial, producing robust, loosely branched stems 40–90 cm tall from a creeping rhizomatous rootstock.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Persicaria barbata - Useful Tropical Plants |url=https://tropical.theferns.info/viewtropical.php?id=Persicaria+barbata |access-date=2025-09-17 |website=tropical.theferns.info}}</ref>

==Varieties==
Two varieties are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''Persicaria barbata'' var. ''barbata''
*''Persicaria barbata'' var. ''gracilis'' {{small|(Danser) H.Hara}}
